The Jasper Plum is one of Dyson's most premium and exclusive colourways. It features a deep, jewel-toned plum-purple finish that is unlike any other shade in the Airwrap range. How the Dyson Airwrap HS-08 i.d. Actually Works

Most people who have not used the Airwrap before ask the same question — how does it curl hair without heat damage? The answer is the Coanda Effect. This is a real scientific principle used in aeronautics — when high-velocity air flows over a curved surface, it creates a pulling force that attracts nearby objects towards it. Dyson's engineers spent years figuring out how to apply this inside a hair styling tool. The result is a barrel that generates a vortex of controlled air, which automatically pulls your hair towards it and wraps it around the barrel on its own.

You do not need to manually twist your hair around the barrel the way you would with a regular curling iron. You do not need to clamp it, hold it in place or worry about burning your fingers. You simply hold the barrel close to your hair and let the airflow do the work. Each section wraps neatly and consistently — which is why the results look so much more polished and even than anything you would get with a conventional tool.

The device never lets the temperature get high enough to cause damage. A built-in sensor reads the air temperature more than 40 times every second and keeps it within a safe range — well below 150°C. Regular curling irons and straighteners operate at 200°C to 230°C. The difference in what those temperatures do to your hair protein over time is enormous. With the Airwrap, your hair stays genuinely healthy — not just looking healthy in the short term, but structurally protected from the inside.

The result is fuller, more defined and more professional-looking curls that hold for longer.

This is the feature that separates the HS-08 i.d. from every other hair tool in the world. Once you connect to the MyDyson app via Bluetooth and complete your hair profile, the device stores your personalised wrap, style and cold shot settings. How Does the Dyson Airwrap Actually Style Hair Without Heat Damage?

This is the question everyone asks — and the answer is genuinely impressive. The Dyson Airwrap uses a scientific phenomenon called the Coanda Effect. In simple words, when high-speed air flows over a curved surface, it naturally pulls nearby objects towards it. Dyson engineers harnessed this to build barrels and brushes that attract your hair using airflow — wrapping it automatically without you having to twist, clamp or manually roll it.

Over time, this causes frizz, split ends, breakage, dryness and fading of coloured hair. The Dyson Airwrap HS-08 i.d. works completely differently. Its intelligent heat control system measures airflow temperature more than 40 times every single second and keeps it safely below 150°C — the threshold at which heat damage begins. A sensor inside the device reads the air temperature more than 40 times per second and constantly adjusts the heating element to keep temperatures in the safe zone. Your hair gets beautifully styled, not damaged. The difference is visible — hair that is styled with the Airwrap stays shiny, strong and smooth even with regular daily use.

No other brand uses Coanda airflow technology. Dyson invented and patented this approach. Every other brand still relies on direct heat applied to hair through metal barrels or hot plates. Dyson styles with air — the difference in hair health over time is significant and visible.

No other brand has app-connected personalisation at this level. Competitors have basic heat settings. Dyson has a full intelligent system that reads your hair type, learns your preferences and automates your styling routine. That is a fundamentally different product category.

Build quality and engineering. Dyson spends more on research and engineering than almost any other consumer product company in the world. Long-term value. A good Dyson Airwrap, properly maintained, will last for years. In that time, it will replace your hair dryer, your curling iron, your smoothing brush and your volumizing tool. Factor in the cost of those individual tools, the salon visits you will skip, and the money saved on hair treatments for heat damage — and the Dyson Airwrap becomes one of the smartest investments you can make for your hair.
